uncovered_shapes.sentence: The Korea Times reports that Nvidia has confirmed planned GPU supply to South Korea will continue despite Jensen Huang's resignation, according to the science minister.

claims.claim: Fermi agreed a deal with an investment-grade hyperscaler to develop 600MW of power at planned Project Matador in Texas, with power beginning next year and $200 million provided up front.
claims.episode_span: develop 600 megawatts of power at planned Project Matador in Texas, with that power to start coming online next year. The customer is providing $200 million up front
claims.source_title: Fermi does 600MW power deal with hyperscaler, but TensorWave lease is officially dead
claims.supporting_quote: The power capacity will be brought online beginning next year, with the customer providing $200 million up front.

claims.claim: Fermi and the hyperscaler have a $15 million early construction agreement and are finalizing a $90 million structural steel and building materials purchase.
claims.episode_span: $15 million under an early construction and site-development agreement, and the two sides are finalizing a $90 million purchase
claims.source_title: Fermi does 600MW power deal with hyperscaler, but TensorWave lease is officially dead
claims.supporting_quote: Alongside the cash to bring the power to the site, the hyperscaler is providing $15 million via an early construction and site development agreement

claims.claim: Fermi and TensorWave terminated the August 2026 lease and the associated AMD credit support agreement.
claims.episode_span: ends the August 2026 TensorWave lease, which had been set for up to 650 megawatts and carried AMD credit support
claims.source_title: Fermi does 600MW power deal with hyperscaler, but TensorWave lease is officially dead
claims.supporting_quote: Fermi and TensorWave have terminated the data center lease and services agreement signed in August 2026. The AMD credit support agreement associated with TensorWave is also terminated.

claims.claim: Fermi reported a $141.6 million net loss for the three months to the end of September and debt of $958.4 million.
claims.episode_span: Fermi reported a $141.6 million net loss, and debt stood at $958.4 million.
claims.source_title: Fermi does 600MW power deal with hyperscaler, but TensorWave lease is officially dead
claims.supporting_quote: Today also saw the firm release its quarterly financial results, which revealed a $141.6 million net loss for the three months to the end of September.

claims.claim: Kioxia and Dell configured 157 PB of raw flash in one 42U rack using 640 of Kioxia's 245.76 TB LC9 SSDs across 16 Dell PowerEdge R7725xd servers.
claims.episode_span: 157 petabytes of raw flash in one 42U rack, running Dell ObjectScale on 16 PowerEdge R7725xd servers that together hold 640
claims.source_title: Kioxia and Dell Build a 157 PB Rack With 640 SSDs
claims.supporting_quote: Kioxia and Dell have managed to fit a massive 157 PB of raw flash storage into a single 42U server rack.

claims.claim: Nscale has brought online two more data centers and about 25,000 GPUs since August 31, 2026, and now reports 50,000 active GPUs out of a planned 461,000.
claims.episode_span: two more data centers and about 25,000 GPUs online since August 31, taking active GPUs to 50,000 of a planned 461,000
claims.source_title: Nscale brings online two data centers and 25,000 GPUs in 2.5 months
claims.supporting_quote: Nscale has brought online a further two data centers and some 25,000 GPUs since August 31, 2026.

claims.claim: Nscale reports 1.37GW of active and contracted capacity, of which 1GW is at owned sites, 200MW at leased sites, and 165MW at colocation.
claims.episode_span: Active and contracted capacity is 1.37 gigawatts: 1 gigawatt at owned sites, 200 megawatts at leased sites, and 165 megawatts in colocation
claims.source_title: Nscale brings online two data centers and 25,000 GPUs in 2.5 months
claims.supporting_quote: In total, Nscale says it has 1.37GW of active and contracted capacity, of which 1GW is at its owned sites, 200MW at leased sites, and 165MW at colocation data centers.

claims.claim: STTGDC inaugurated NOI2, a 22MW data center in Noida, and Neysa is set to place some 9,000 GPUs there.
claims.episode_span: energized a 22-megawatt data center, NOI2, in Noida, Uttar Pradesh
claims.source_title: STTGDC launches 22MW data center in Noida, India
claims.supporting_quote: The company last week announced the inauguration of STTGDC NOI2, a 22MW data center in Noida.

claims.claim: JLL forecasts national tender prices will rise 4.2% in 2027, up from 3.1% in 2026.
claims.episode_span: national tender prices up 4.2 percent in 2027, from 3.1 percent in 2026
claims.source_title: Labor Shortages Threaten Data Center Schedules
claims.supporting_quote: In its 2027 US Construction Perspective, JLL forecasts national tender prices – what contractors bid for projects – will rise 4.2% in 2027, up from 3.1% in 2026 and above the pre-2020 norm of 2% to 3%.

claims.claim: OpenAI informed lawmakers it would support bills restricting China's access to advanced AI semiconductors, indirect Nvidia shipments, and ASML equipment, with lawmakers seeking to fold them into the NDAA.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI has told US lawmakers it will support a bipartisan package to restrict China's access to advanced AI chips and chipmaking tools
claims.source_title: OpenAI backs US bills to tighten AI chip export controls to China
claims.supporting_quote: Congress is advancing three bills: restricting exports of advanced AI Semiconductor to China, blocking indirect shipments of Nvidia's AI chips, and limiting China's access to advanced equipment from Dutch chip-gear maker ASML.

claims.claim: ViTrox says nearly 200 V810Ai QX1 X-ray inspection systems were deployed within one year at major global AI-server manufacturers.
claims.episode_span: nearly 200 of its V810Ai QX1 automated X-ray systems have been deployed within one year
claims.source_title: ViTrox Reports Nearly 200 AI-Powered X-Ray Inspection Systems Deployed
claims.supporting_quote: Nearly 200 units have been deployed within one year across major global AI-server manufacturers, demonstrating strong market traction and industry adoption.

claims.claim: Teledyne demonstrated single-pass inspection of a 300mm wafer at 10 micrometre resolution with a 32K line-scan camera using 2.5 micrometre pixels and speeds up to 150 kHz.
claims.episode_span: inspecting the wafer in a single pass at 10 micrometre resolution
claims.source_title: Teledyne Vision Solutions Demonstrates Single-Pass 300mm Wafer Inspection
claims.supporting_quote: The Linea ML 32K demonstration will show how a 300mm semiconductor wafer can be inspected in a single pass at 10 µm resolution.
